# Exam Builder

> Question-paper preparation for teachers and schools in Pakistan, including academies.

Public information is available in English and Urdu. Available curriculum varies; board selection is not a guarantee of complete syllabus coverage.

Schools can try the paper-building tools free before choosing a paid subscription. Current trial duration and plan prices are published on the pricing page. Renewals are manually reviewed after JazzCash/Easypaisa payment and WhatsApp proof. No automatic billing.

Schools add their own questions; a complete ready-made syllabus question bank is currently not included. Question contributions are shared by matching curriculum; saved school papers remain private application content. Do not infer official board affiliation or complete all-board coverage.
